notes: GOAL.template.md was NOT edited. T002 already asserted it must not change in this delivery, and it already carries the marker on the first line and satisfies compatible() as-is -- verified before writing any test, not assumed. Wrote tests/validate_goal_document_contract.py as a single unittest module, stdlib only, following the shape of tests/validate_workflow_contract.py / validate_workflow_v3_contract.py. It imports ESSENTIAL, MARKER, compatible and managed_version from grill_core.goal_document (scripts/ pushed onto sys.path, mirroring ensure_goal.py's own documented import contract) and never redeclares any of them (T024). resolve_goal/atomic_create are exercised directly via `import ensure_goal` for T028b/T030, since those need the GoalResult tuple, not just the CLI's JSON line. Two implementation gotchas found and fixed while writing the suite: (1) T026's per-item removal used str.replace(item, '', 1) at first, which silently passed for 'GOAL-HOLD:' and 'PLAN_ONLY_STOP' because those substrings repeat more than once in the template -- removing only the first occurrence left the item still present, so compatible() stayed True and the regression would have gone undetected; fixed by removing every occurrence (replace(item, '') with no count). (2) T029's SSOT scan initially excluded any path containing '.git' in its parts to skip repository-internal files, but this worktree itself lives under <repo>/.git/grill/wt-.../, so an absolute-path '.git' check discarded every single file, including grill_core/goal_document.py, and the test always found zero hits; fixed by checking '.git' only in the path *relative to the scanned base* (plugin/ or tests/), which is what SC-006 actually means by 'exactly one file in the source tree'.
